message.content:
I don’t have a live “fetch” function for holiday calendars, but here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian public‑holiday long weekends that occurred in 2023 (based on the federal holidays that fall on a weekday adjacent to a weekend):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick) | Monday, Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday, Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sat Apr 8 |
| Victoria Day | Monday, May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| Labour Day | Monday, Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday, Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Thursday, Nov 11 | Wed Nov 10 – Fri Nov 12 |
| Christmas Day | Monday, Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday, Dec 26 | Thu Dec 24 – Sun Dec 27 |

**Notes**

* **New Year’s Day** (Sunday, Jan 1) and **Canada Day** (Saturday, Jul 1) fell on weekends, so they didn’t create an extra day off.  
* Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) that can also produce long weekends; you’ll need to check the specific provincial calendars if you’re targeting those regions.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it formatted differently!
